profile.text: Typhon, a Sarkaz active in Sami, considers herself a hunter and has both the knowledge and skills to deal with the dangers of Sami's natural environment. At Operator Magallan's invitation, she is currently cooperating with Rhodes Island and assisting in our affairs in Sami and the endless icefields.
